verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents a search feature designed to work without a network connection (docs-86) and Ask AI natural-language retrieval over the inbox (docs-4, docs-18). Hands-on reports on speed are mixed: one user calls search blazing fast, while an ex-user says archive searches regularly took ten seconds versus instant in Gmail. missing for 10: documented search operators, filters, ranked results, explicit coverage of full mail history, consistent independent confirmation of search speed.
